title: Finding a specific named sub-location (e.g. the Hundred Gallery, the Drowned Nave, the oath-stone) often required blind directional wandering across several unnamed rooms before the target appeared in 'get your bearings' — bearings is free and great once discovered, but it's easy to not think to use it right away in a new hold.
